Письмо другу / Uma carta a um amigo: Письмо другу / A letter to a friend
Oi, Anton! Como vai? Estou em Moscou ago: Hi, Anton! How are you? I'm in Moscow now. I arrived a week ago and I'll be here for two more weeks. I live in a small apartment on the third floor. There is a park and the metro nearby. Every morning I drink tea and walk in the park. Yesterday it was cold, so I bought a warm jacket. If it's sunny tomorrow, Nina and I will go to the museum. Please write and tell me how you are! Bye! Max
— Olá. Estou com dor de garganta. O que: — Hello. I have a sore throat. What do you recommend?
— Aqui estão comprimidos para dor de gar: — Here are tablets for a sore throat. Take them three times a day, after meals.
— Está bem, levo. Preciso também de um c: — OK, I'll take them. I also need a glass of water.
— Aqui está. Melhoras!: — Here you are. Get well soon!
Responda em voz alta: onde está o Max, o: Answer aloud: where is Max, what does he do every day and what did he buy, and what would you do in his place.
